chs.name: 荆棘之矛
chs.description: 矛术。 命中时，使目标敌人「流血」5...20秒。
chs.concise: 矛术。 命中时，使目标敌人「流血」5...20秒。

de.name: Stachelspeer

de-guildwiki.name: Stachelspeer
de-guildwiki.description: Wenn dieser Angriff erfolgreich ist, leidet der Gegner 5...20 Sekunden lang an einer Blutung.

en.name: Barbed Spear
en.description: Spear Attack. If this attack hits, your target begins Bleeding for 5...20 seconds.

en-gww.name: Barbed Spear
en-gww.description: If this attack hits, your target begins Bleeding for 5...20 seconds.

fr-gwiki.name: Javelot perforant

ru.name: Barbed Spear
